# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.2 Stage 3 Package 2B, Late Iran 1411-1560 (oe_irt_). Generated by gen_iran_late.py; edit the generator, not this file.


# Initialize Late Iran (1411-1560) global state (idempotent; starts after gen_ilkhanate.py's 1411 close).
oe_irt_init = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_init } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_init value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_on value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_stage value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_turcoman_lord value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_uzun_state value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_despina_pact value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_gunpowder_reform value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_safavid_path value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_chaldiran_lesson value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_centralization value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_cnt value = 0 }
    }
}

# Bilateral opinion helper for Despina Khatun Pontic-Aq Qoyunlu / Iranian alliance.
oe_irt_apply_despina_bias = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:AQQ country_exists = c:TRE }
        c:AQQ = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_irt_b_despina_alliance target = c:TRE } }
        c:TRE = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_irt_b_despina_alliance target = c:AQQ } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:AQQ country_exists = c:BYZ }
        c:AQQ = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_irt_b_despina_alliance target = c:BYZ } }
        c:BYZ = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_irt_b_despina_alliance target = c:AQQ } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:IRA country_exists = c:BYZ }
        c:IRA = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_irt_b_despina_alliance target = c:BYZ } }
        c:BYZ = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_irt_b_despina_alliance target = c:IRA } }
    }
}

# Bilateral opinion helper for Chaldiran gunpowder frontier hostility with TUR.
oe_irt_apply_chaldiran_bias = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:IRA country_exists = c:TUR }
        c:IRA = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_irt_b_chaldiran_frontier target = c:TUR } }
        c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_irt_b_chaldiran_frontier target = c:IRA } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:AQQ country_exists = c:TUR }
        c:AQQ = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_irt_b_chaldiran_frontier target = c:TUR } }
        c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_irt_b_chaldiran_frontier target = c:AQQ } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:QAR country_exists = c:TUR }
        c:QAR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_irt_b_chaldiran_frontier target = c:TUR } }
        c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_irt_b_chaldiran_frontier target = c:QAR } }
    }
}

# Fire event $ev$ to the best target among Iranian & regional realms (prefers human player).
oe_irt_dispatch = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:IRA c:IRA = { is_ai = no } }
        c:IRA = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:AQQ c:AQQ = { is_ai = no } }
        c:AQQ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:QAR c:QAR = { is_ai = no } }
        c:QAR = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TIM c:TIM = { is_ai = no } }
        c:TIM = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:JAL c:JAL = { is_ai = no } }
        c:JAL = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:INJ c:INJ = { is_ai = no } }
        c:INJ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KRT c:KRT = { is_ai = no } }
        c:KRT = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { is_ai = no } }
        c:TRE = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_ai = no } }
        c:BYZ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { is_ai = no } }
        c:TUR = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:IRA }
        c:IRA = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:AQQ }
        c:AQQ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:QAR }
        c:QAR = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TIM }
        c:TIM = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:JAL }
        c:JAL = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KRT }
        c:KRT = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:INJ }
        c:INJ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TRE }
        c:TRE = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR }
        c:TUR = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
        c:BYZ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.$ev$ }
    }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_cnt add = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_m value = oe_irt_m_now }
}

# Specialized dispatch for .3 Despina Khatun: prioritizes human TRE / BYZ / AQQ first.
oe_irt_dispatch_despina = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TRE c:TRE = { is_ai = no } }
        c:TRE = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.3 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_cnt add = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_m value = oe_irt_m_now }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_ai = no } }
        c:BYZ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.3 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_cnt add = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_m value = oe_irt_m_now }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:AQQ c:AQQ = { is_ai = no } }
        c:AQQ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_irt.3 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_cnt add = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_m value = oe_irt_m_now }
    }
    else = {
        oe_irt_dispatch = { ev = 3 }
    }
}

# Monthly tick (scheduler slot 54, also called by oe_irt_fallback_pulse if BYZ falls or slot 54 not yet wired).
# Begins firing events from 1411+ right after gen_ilkhanate.py closes. Takes NO BYZ main-line lock.
oe_irt_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_irt_ran_m ?= oe_irt_m_now } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ran_m value = oe_irt_m_now }
        oe_irt_init = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_on oe_irt_any_alive = yes current_year >= 1411 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_irt_ev_m ?= oe_irt_m_now } }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes current_year >= 1411 current_year < 1445 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_ev_1 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_1 value = 1 }
                    oe_irt_dispatch = { ev = 1 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1455 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_ev_2 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_2 value = 1 }
                    oe_irt_dispatch = { ev = 2 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1458 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_ev_3 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_3 value = 1 }
                    oe_irt_dispatch_despina = yes
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1473 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_ev_4 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_4 value = 1 }
                    oe_irt_dispatch = { ev = 4 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1501 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_ev_5 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_5 value = 1 }
                    oe_irt_dispatch = { ev = 5 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1514 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_ev_6 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_6 value = 1 }
                    oe_irt_dispatch = { ev = 6 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1540 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_ev_7 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_7 value = 1 }
                    oe_irt_dispatch = { ev = 7 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { current_year >= 1555 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_ev_8 } }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_irt_ev_8 value = 1 }
                    oe_irt_dispatch = { ev = 8 }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year >= 1560 has_global_variable = oe_irt_ev_8 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_irt_on
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_irt_test_start = {
    oe_irt_test_clear = yes
    oe_irt_init = yes
}

oe_irt_test_month = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_init } } oe_irt_init = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_ran_m } remove_global_variable = oe_irt_ran_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_irt_ev_m } remove_global_variable = oe_irt_ev_m }
    oe_irt_monthly = yes
}
